# Séance 0.3.29
Phones and iPads now take turns with your Macs the same way Macs do with each other. Switching to Terminal on the phone brings the chat's terminal there; the Mac, and any other screen showing it, keeps its last picture softly blurred with a Use Here button. Clicking or typing on the Mac no longer pulls the terminal back from the phone, and typing on a covered phone goes nowhere.
On iPhone and iPad, a terminal taken over from a Mac now fills the screen. Before, it was pushed to the left with its first columns cut off.
After the phone comes back from the background, its terminal returns to the phone's own size instead of staying a couple of rows short.
